finalists.label: Cherubism
finalists.why: It has the most specific for evidence, including progressive, bilateral, painless swelling of the jaws and symmetrical enlargement of the mandible and maxilla, with no against evidence.

finalists.label: Odontogenic cyst
finalists.why: It has specific for evidence, including well-defined, multilocular radiolucent areas involving the mandibular bodies, angles, ascending rami, and the maxillary tuberosities, with no against evidence.

frontier_selector.why: The champion is chosen because it has the most specific for evidence, including symmetrical enlargement of the mandible and maxilla, which is not explained by the runner-up.
